stopping_samples.policy: actual available memory plus own unused cap; peer ceilings are informational

v2_runner_change: Container/TUI names only; resource guard changes PSI from kill to annotation. Actual-headroom inequality and owned cap remain strict.
limits: Three single-repetition samples per arm in one fixed mirrored cohort; empirical layout band, no confidence interval or acceptance threshold.
PSI/activity annotations and all six rates retained. Activity covers whole command intervals, not exact PP/TG phases.
Original artifact hashes differ for main Q1/TQ2/shared modules; no numerical implication or equivalence claim yet.
Binary/model payloads remain on rig; completed runner checked pins before executing. Offline audit crosschecks declared pins and copied build receipts, not a fresh payload execution.
DPM markers are driver state samples, not instantaneous clocks.
disposition: Retain the current Q2 candidate for final existing-path checks. The repeated comparison shows a small prefill cost and a decode gain versus mx. This behavior-equivalent control has much smaller median shifts. Its pooled range also includes activity noise and is not a universal error bar. Preserve the slow candidate call in the matched comparison and report both phases; do not claim every sample or phase beats mx.
